suites.name: full_symmetry
suites.scope: Exact branching, PS/SM/EM commutant dimensions and ranks, degree-five sterile exchange, neutral-vector and broken-generator controls

suites.name: fixed_current

suites.name: moving_geometry

suites.name: graph_trace
